findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot paginate audit-log datetime values
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint uses this paginator with order_by="-datetime", so get_item_key receives a datetime object. math.floor/math.ceil cannot convert a datetime and raise TypeError when build_cursor processes any nonempty result set. Consequently, eligible users requesting optimized_pagination=true get a server error instead of audit logs. The cursor conversion also returns a raw number rather than a datetime for subsequent queries. Use the DateTimePaginator key encoding and decoding for this endpoint.

findings.title: Django querysets do not support the advertised negative-offset slicing
findings.body: When advanced features are enabled and a cursor has a negative offset (for example, 0:-1:0), this branch passes that offset directly to QuerySet slicing. Django explicitly rejects negative slice indices with ValueError; it does not handle these boundary conditions automatically as the comment claims. Thus the new negative-offset feature produces a server error rather than reverse pagination. Translate offsets into supported nonnegative queries or reject them with a pagination validation error before slicing.
